source: lab (captured; background replaced with Segment Anything 2 - effectively a segmentation video)
pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1280x720 frame

camera.motion: static (background is a fixed replaced image; pixel-identical between frames outside the objects)
camera.perspective_cues: none: no floor, walls or horizon visible (synthetic snowy blue-to-white gradient background). Depth changes visible only through apparent size (circle_diam / mask_width columns).

timing_anomalies.what: one source frame dropped: every object's frame-to-frame step doubles (basketball 11->21 px, yellow 35->68, grey 32->66, soccer 10->21)
probably one source frame dropped: basketball step 27 -> 53 -> 24 px (only object moving then)

objects.name: basketball
objects.description: orange basketball (black seams, 'Wilson' print); the largest orange object. Starts held lower right (x~875,y~667, bottom cut by image edge), thrown up-left away from camera, hits something (wall/backboard, not visible) and rebounds toward camera.
objects.ref_point: least-squares circle fit to the mask's convex hull (ball centre)

objects.name: soccer_ball
objects.description: black-and-white soccer ball, right side (x~913,y~615 while held). Held (hand masked out) frames 0-22, thrown up and slightly left, moving away from camera (shrinks) until the end. From frame 27 the segmentation shows it only as a faint texture-less grey disc.
objects.ref_point: circle fit (frames 0-38 to mask hull; 39-48 disc fitted to the texture-less fill)

objects.name: yellow_object
objects.description: small yellow ball (looks like a tennis ball / lemon; elongated in early frames only by motion blur). Enters from the left edge at frame 17 flying up-right, arcs over, falls, bounces at frame 37 and rises again; travels together with grey_object, moving away from camera.
objects.apparent_size_px: width across motion ~39-42 px at frames 18-22 (length 75-85 incl. blur); ~23 px at 42-44; ~21.5 at 48

objects.name: grey_object
objects.description: light grey/off-white oval ball (slightly larger than yellow_object), flying next to and slightly ahead/above the yellow one along a similar arc; bounces at frame 38. Appears suddenly at frame 20 and vanishes after frame 47 (segmentation limits).
objects.apparent_size_px: width ~50 px at frames 20-21 (length ~81-85 incl. blur); ~31 px at 41-43; ~24-25 at 45-47

objects.name: hand/person
objects.description: not visible: the thrower's hands are masked out; they cause the occlusion of basketball (0-10) and soccer ball (0-24).

objects.name: watermark
objects.description: text 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo', bottom-right box x 1030-1280, y 692-720 (not a scene object)

events.event: basketball starts moving (throw begins; held/occluded until ~10)
basketball released, free flight from 11/12 on
yellow_object enters at the left edge, flying up-right
soccer ball starts moving up (throw/release ~23-24; free from ~25)
yellow_object apex of its arc (min y 237.6 px); grey_object apex frame 27-28 (y~199)
yellow_object bounce (lowest point y 489, then rises)
grey_object bounce (lowest point y 471, then rises)
basketball impact/rebound: x and y motion reverse, apparent size stops shrinking and grows (comes back toward camera)
end of clip (yellow nearly horizontal motion, near new apex)
